title: Harbourside Pharmacy — Whitstable
mocks: Fictional pharmacy, staff, registrations, NHS status, prices and care/logistics promises unverified. Original counter illustration and monogram profiles. London-time example opening pill handles lunch/weekends, not bank holidays. Three service routes, eight information dialogs, sample clinics, local repeat checklist and clinic date preparation; no personal/medical fields. No Rx order, GP contact, dispensing, eligibility decision, live calendar, delivery or clinical service.
